tianxia.tradition.spirit.mudang.feature..why: Prepared Gut Circle, Pacification Petition, Public Diagnosis and hospitality (combat/ext/mudang_ritual.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.ancestral_chann.why: Ancestor Offices: a standing free choice of two Offices (three with Legacy Made Present) that gates the Borrow the Office and Ancestral Ascension buttons (combat/ext/ancestral_channeler.py).

Borrow the Office: once on each of your turns a Spirit Awakening feature applies the borrowed Office's expression (Healer Temporary HP, Warrior no Opportunity Attacks, Wayfarer 5-foot step) (combat/ext/ancestral_channeler.py).

While ascended: the Ascendant Office's expression, once-per-turn Spiritual Pressure on a Resonance Marked creature within 60 feet, and one Ascendant Office Authority (combat/ext/ancestral_channeler.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.black_current_w.why: Reaction, 2 Resonance, when a creature declares an attack on you: move up to 10 feet without provoking (the attack misses if you leave its reach), else +2 AC against it; Carry the Reed (combat/ext/black_current_walker.py).

+10 feet Speed; exchange positions with a Resonance Marked creature once per turn; Black Current steps out of a Grapple; Undertow Pursuit stays its generic 'moved 15 feet' reaction (combat/ext/black_current_walker.py).
Black River Domain: allied Speed, footing, 5-foot step and Temporary HP; Hostile Banks save; Ten Thousand Tributaries; River Leaves No Corpse Behind (combat/ext/black_current_walker.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.candlemaker.fea.why: Soul Candle (a held Asset: its Hit Points are a pool), counted Soul-Wick Marks that count as your Resonance Mark, the Candle Marking Rite's Disadvantage (combat/ext/candlemaker.py).
Reaction, 6 Resonance: a creature within 30 feet about to drop to 0 HP stays at 1 HP; the Soul Candle is extinguished (combat/ext/candlemaker.py).
Lantern field: allies' Advantage on death and mental saves, Soul-Wick or Pressure on their successes, Last Wick Extinguishes (combat/ext/candlemaker.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.why: Chorus Recognition: Revealed Disturbance on a Witness-Noted hostile creature that becomes Resonance Marked (combat/ext/choir_of_the_unopened_eye.py).
Field: ordinary invisibility grants no Advantage against you; once per round Spiritual Pressure on a hostile creature marked in it (combat/ext/choir_of_the_unopened_eye.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin.why: Pole and Bearing tokens, the start-of-turn Bearing, Compass Strike, No Blind Side to the Soul (combat/ext/compass_breaking_hand.py).
Reaction, 2 Resonance and a token, when your Pole attacks you or an ally within 15 feet; Read Their Bearing (combat/ext/compass_breaking_hand.py).
+10 feet Speed, footing while completing a Bearing, Break the Restraining Direction (combat/ext/compass_breaking_hand.py).
Compass Domain: Chosen Bearings, False North, Turn the Whole Field, Compass-Breaking Procession (combat/ext/compass_breaking_hand.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dream_eater.fea.why: Dream Morsels from creatures that fail your Dream Eater saves while asleep, helpless, Frightened or scarred; target gates (combat/ext/dream_eater.py).
Steal a Dream Fragment when a scarred creature fails your save (2 Resonance or 1 Morsel, once per turn); confront its dreamer (combat/ext/dream_eater.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dreamweaver.fea.why: Reaction, 1 Resonance: Disadvantage on a hostile attack within 60 feet; a miss leaves a Resonance Mark or a Dream Thread (combat/ext/dreamweaver.py).
Reaction, 2 Resonance when a creature escapes your World of One; Dream-Thread Passage (combat/ext/dreamweaver.py).
At 0 HP (6 Resonance, once per fight): Unconscious and Stable in a 20-foot Dream Refuge for up to 3 rounds (combat/ext/dreamweaver.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea.why: Reaction, 3 Resonance: a Resonance Marked creature's attack technique on your side -- Charisma save, 4d8 + Wisdom Psychic and Disadvantage on that attack (combat/ext/echo_scribe.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci.why: Reaction, 2 Resonance, when a creature attacks you: leave an Echo Position and move 10 feet without provoking; out of reach it misses, else +2 AC; on a miss choose Psychic damage, Mind Spike, a move to another Echo or no Reactions. Cross the Blade-Hum on a hostile crossing your Echo Positions (combat/ext/echo_step_disciple.py).

When you damage a creature Resonance Marked by you, 2 Resonance turns the mark into a Pursuit Mark for the fight; Follow the Vanishing Point still compiles as the generic moved reaction (combat/ext/echo_step_disciple.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.equal_measure_s.why: Measures (Impact, Motion, Intent pools) received once per round from a hostile Action or Bonus Action that harms you or a marked ally within 30 feet; Measured Return spends one on your Martial Strike (combat/ext/equal_measure_scripture.py).

Reaction, 2 Resonance and the matching Measure: cut a hostile damage packet by 3d8 + Wisdom, cut a push or pull by 20 feet or prevent Prone, or add 1d6 to a failed Int/Wis/Cha save (combat/ext/equal_measure_scripture.py).
Convert the Measure buttons (Bonus Action, 1 Resonance) and Counterweight Becomes Counterstrike (combat/ext/equal_measure_scripture.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.fate_reader.fea.why: Reaction, 4 Resonance: +/-1d8 on a roll by a creature you see within 60 feet before its outcome; an unwilling creature's Charisma save cuts it to 1d4 with Spiritual Pressure; a changed outcome gives 1 Fate Tension (combat/ext/fate_reader.py).

Reaction, 6 Resonance and 1 Fate Tension: delay you or an ally within 30 feet dropping to 0 Hit Points or becoming Charmed or Frightened until the end of its next turn, with an Ending Token (combat/ext/fate_reader.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.grief_eater.fea.why: Sorrow Burdens (1 a turn, from Bloodied, Frightened, Charmed, 0 Hit Points or death within 60 feet) and Taste of Sorrow's Reaction mark (combat/ext/grief_eater.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.halo_eater.feat.why: Stolen Radiance (1 a turn from a hostile creature's healing, Temporary HP or new blessing within 60 feet) and Taste the Radiance's Reaction: Temporary HP and savoring (combat/ext/halo_eater.py).
Reaction, 3 Resonance and 1 Stolen Radiance at the same moment: Restoring, Warding, Cleansing or Reflecting Shape (combat/ext/halo_eater.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.inner_soul_gate.why: Rooted Identity, Root Reclamation, Root Opening (combat/ext/inner_soul_gate.py).
Sacral Reorientation (a d20 rewrite) and Sacral Opening (combat/ext/inner_soul_gate.py).
Heart Attunement (a d20 rewrite), the Heart Restoration button and Heart Opening (combat/ext/inner_soul_gate.py).
Crown Opening: all four Openings, Spiritual Truesight, save Advantage and a once-per-round success (combat/ext/inner_soul_gate.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.knot_weaver.fea.why: Observed Ties, Knot Tension and Tug the Visible Thread (combat/ext/knot_weaver.py); Red Thread Sense still compiles.
Reaction, 3 Resonance or 1 Knot Tension: -1d6 to a tied, marked creature's attack or save, or tug its move (combat/ext/knot_weaver.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.last_inch_palm..why: Spirit-Touch Unarmed Strike, Handspan Subject, Handspan Reach and Last-Inch Step (combat/ext/last_inch_palm.py).
Reaction, 2 Resonance, before a Handspan Subject's melee attack on you or an adjacent creature: +10 feet of required reach or +2 AC, then Palm at the Threshold (combat/ext/last_inch_palm.py).
Contact Without Adjacency, Follow the Contact and Open the Gripping Hand (combat/ext/last_inch_palm.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.law_of_near_and.why: Near relations, the free 10-foot step toward a Near creature, and Far Relation's Reaction (combat/ext/near_and_far.py); Name What Is Near still compiles.
Reaction, 3 Resonance: an attack or single-target hostile save against you or a Near creature is made Far; Far Shore Counter (combat/ext/near_and_far.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mercy_flayer.fe.why: Mercy Scar rupture (a d20 rewrite on a failed Int/Wis/Cha save); Gentle Knife still compiles (combat/ext/mercy_flayer.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.miko.feature.mi.why: Two chosen Minor Kami Favors: Clear Water and Guiding Wind buttons, Favor of the Hearth (a d20 rewrite) (combat/ext/miko.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mirror_speaker..why: Reaction, 2 Resonance: before an attack on you or an ally within 30 feet, or a forced Int/Wis/Cha save; Reflected Consequence (combat/ext/mirror_speaker.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.plain_truth_fis.why: Open Declaration buttons, Credence, and Truth-Forged Strike (combat/ext/plain_truth_fist.py).
Reaction, 2 Resonance: a marked hostile creature beginning its turn within 60 feet -> Intents and Contradiction (combat/ext/plain_truth_fist.py).
Unbroken Word and Contradiction Leaves an Opening (combat/ext/plain_truth_fist.py); Call the False Form still compiles.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.seraphic_molter.why: The Minor Seraphic Sign (a standing free choice): Glass-Eye Sign's range and Feather-Scar Sign's save and step (combat/ext/seraphic_molter.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.why: Reaction, 1 Resonance: a creature within 30 feet is defeated -> a Soul Fragment with its custody status; Fragment Use buttons (combat/ext/soul_warden.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soulstring_danc.why: Choreography Strings on a failed save, Threaded Step's 5-foot move, Dancer's Counterstep (combat/ext/soulstring_dancer.py).
Reaction, 4 Resonance: hit while a String bearer is within 30 feet (combat/ext/soulstring_dancer.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..why: Submission Shock (Reaction, 1 Mandate) and Command the Marked (combat/ext/sovereign_will.py).
Hegemon's Domain after Domain Manifestation: Court of Submission, Court Tax, Absolute Edict (combat/ext/sovereign_will.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.unwritten_footp.why: Between-Thought Strike and Misattribute the Blow (Reaction, 2 Resonance) (combat/ext/unwritten_footprint.py).
Erase the Last Passage (Reaction, 5 Resonance) when an attack targets you (combat/ext/unwritten_footprint.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.well_of_hours.f.why: Echo of the Chosen Step (the Before-Space and its Bonus Action) and Time Debt (combat/ext/well_of_hours.py).
Borrowed Second's option buttons and Pay the Second Back (combat/ext/well_of_hours.py).
Refuse the Moment (Reaction, 6 Resonance): the deferred consequence (combat/ext/well_of_hours.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.yokai_channeler.why: Lineage Gift reactions and Wall-Clinging Thread (combat/ext/yokai_channeler.py); the Tell is not a combat ability.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.exorcist.featur.why: Ghost Sight creature-qualified Spiritual Sense range; Name the Intruder is its owned Bonus Action.
Native Ghost, Undead Soul and Restless Dead: after Mind Spike fails, optional 2 Resonance Charisma save with one-minute Frightened and repeats. Other printed outcomes remain pending.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea.why: Record the Disturbance records one visible category when the owner places a Resonance Mark; diagnostic Ink Remembers remains an action.
